business_problem: Melbourne Airport, the second busiest in Australia, is a key connector for the country’s travel and transportation. The operational team needed to upgrade its data analytics capabilities to improve operational efficiency and passenger experience.
solution_summary: Melbourne Airport built this solution on Microsoft Fabric, Power BI. Melbourne Airport, the second busiest in Australia, is a key connector for the country’s travel and transportation. The operational team needed to upgrade its data analytics capabilities to improve operational efficiency and passenger experience. Microsoft Fabric unifies lake, warehouse, and analytics workloads on a governed data foundation. Power BI publishes dashboards and self-service analytics to business users. Seeking to democratize data across its various departments, the airport found its solution in Microsoft Fabric. Business units can now engage directly with the data, thanks to the intuitive interface of Fabric and its low-code/no-code applications. Operational data is collected from line-of-business systems, unified in Microsoft Fabric before Power BI dashboards surface insights to business users.
